summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Data Cleanup API and UI. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified working - Data Cleanup section accessible via Admin Portal > Settings > Data Cleanup with all 3 tabs (Data Cleanup, Team Players, Health Alerts) functional.
critical_code_review_comments: cleanup.py properly implements all 5 player data sources: users.teamId, users.teamAssignments, legacy league_data.players, team.roster, team.players
DataCleanupManager.js correctly displays all 5 sources with counts and player details
API endpoints properly return structured data with correct field names
Preview mode (confirm=false) works correctly for clear-all-players endpoint
Health alert settings properly saved and retrieved from league_data.healthAlertSettings
context_for_next_testing_agent: Data Cleanup feature fully functional. Access via Admin Portal > Settings > Data Cleanup. Team Players tab shows all 5 data sources. Eagles team (eagles_01) has 3 players in Sources 1 and 2. Database is healthy with 0 orphaned records.

backend_apis.GET /api/cleanup/database-stats: Working - returns users (total/active/pending/inactive), teams, legacy_players, team_roster_entries
backend_apis.GET /api/cleanup/team/{team_id}/player-s: Working - returns all 5 player data sources with counts
backend_apis.POST /api/cleanup/team/{team_id}/clear-a: Working - preview mode returns sources, confirm=true clears all
backend_apis.GET /api/cleanup/orphaned-players/previe: Working - returns legacy_players, orphaned_team_assignments, users_without_valid_teams, total_issues
backend_apis.POST /api/cleanup/orphaned-players/clean: Working - removes orphaned data and returns cleanup counts
